headline: Electronics exceed 10% of Mexico's manufacturing GDP for the first time since 2005
summary: Electronic component manufacturing in Mexico grew 23.2% year on year in real terms, accounting for 61% of the electronics industry's gain in the third quarter of 2026. The sector's share of manufacturing output exceeded 10%.
why: Mexico is a major manufacturing and export hub, so growth in electronics affects its trade balance and its appeal to multinational supply chains.
original_headline: La electrónica supera 10% del PIB manufacturero de México por primera vez desde 2005
